review.same_repo_followup: One arm only. Score H from Initialization100 plus H's warmup tasks. Require at least two distinct prior tasks after exclusion. Repository identity is parsed from the inference-time owner__repository-final_numeric_issue task ID with casefolding and fail-closed fallback. DROP if either headline cost has negative paired utility; otherwise KEEP for mechanism work only. No CI, p-value, or deployment claim.

At kv3500 the only two nonzero task deltas are both harmful (-6895.74 ms spdx tools-python; -2864.14 ms Faker). At kv5000 the positive net is mixed (+2/-2 tasks) and concentrated in Faker and DVC. This is too sparse and cost-inconsistent to justify the added conditioning. Close the same_repo arm; do not rescue it with post-hoc guard or cost tuning.
